description: This Java interface defines a contract for matching payload paths against patterns to produce internal command names within the Ditto protocol adapter context.

classes.name: PayloadPathMatcher
classes.description: An interface for matching payload paths to internal command names, throwing an exception if no match is found.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Attempts to match a given JsonPointer payload path to known patterns and returns the corresponding command name, or throws UnknownPathException if no match is found.
